nodes.title: Computational Electromagnetic Analysis of Hybrid Plasmonic Waveguides for Compact Optical interconnects
nodes.venue: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology Repository (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
nodes.venue_abbr: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology Repository (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
nodes.summary: 该研究采用 COMSOL 二维有限元本征模分析，模拟 Ag/PTFE/Si 混合等离激元波导。在1550 nm波长下，摘要报告有效模场面积约为0.04 λ²、传播长度约为170 µm。结构通过30 nm PTFE间隙实现局域光场约束。
